name: Safe Intake Proof 001
problem: Teams need a safer way to prepare documents before AI search, summarisation, or retrieval touches sensitive material.
evidence: Demonstrates document intake, classification, quarantine, review states, approval gates, evidence ledger events, AI-ingestion blocking, and controlled workflow transitions.
Framed as a working proof, not production software, a compliance product, or a full platform.

name: AI Website Builder Prompt Library
problem: AI website builders can drift into fake claims, weak structure, inaccessible layouts, and generic copy without a controlled brief.
evidence: Defines reusable prompts for personal brand sites, client intake, service pages, visual direction, accessibility checks, and claim audits.
Includes rules to avoid fake testimonials, unsupported metrics, invented client logos, and unsafe user input handling.

name: LAB AI & Tech Solutions Website
problem: LAB needs a public proof layer that explains what it does, who it helps, why it is different, what proof exists, and how to engage.
evidence: Homepage direction centred on Safe Intake Proof 001, evidence-first positioning, and controlled AI workflows.
Repository used as the source of truth for website build decisions and implementation.

name: Subzteveø Creative Systems
problem: Creative AI and music workflows need structure without removing human judgement, taste, or authorship.
evidence: Explores language, sound, prompting, Ableton workflows, public writing, and creative technology systems.
Positioned as creative practice, not an automated content factory.
